freelookplus.config.title: Freelook Plus
freelookplus.config.enabled.desc:
While you use Freelook, moving the mouse turns only the camera. You can look around without changing the direction you face.

Assign the key under Controls → Freelook Plus.

Under Movement, you can choose for which kinds of movement it can be used.
freelookplus.config.key_mode.desc:
Hold: Freelook is used while the key is held.

Toggle: each press of the key starts or stops Freelook. It also stops whenever it can't be used, for example when you switch to a kind of movement that is turned off under Movement.
freelookplus.config.on_foot.desc: Freelook can be used when you are not riding anything, swimming or flying with an elytra.
freelookplus.config.swimming.desc: Freelook can be used while sprint-swimming underwater.
freelookplus.config.elytra.desc: Freelook can be used while flying with an elytra.
freelookplus.config.minecart.desc: Freelook can be used while riding a minecart.
freelookplus.config.boat.desc: Freelook can be used while riding a boat or raft.
freelookplus.config.mount.desc: Freelook can be used while riding anything else, such as a horse, pig or strider.
